hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.status: HS-Stroke discovery cohort; R8-B's LEAKED / PLACEBO outcomes on these arms are known (L - P +9.40 BA); the split-half arms L1 / L2 have never been trained, so the decomposition outcomes are new. Exploratory with respect to the total, first-time with respect to the decomposition.
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.question: Is R8-B's EEGNet benchmark inflation exposure (own copy) or support (extra distinct same-run test trials)? R8-B bounded support only through CLEAN - LCB, which assumes diminishing returns and exchangeability of the removed non-test trials with the extra test-trial copies.
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.C1: exposure with support fixed: BA of exposed scored trials in their own-exposed half arm minus the other-half arm > 0
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.C2: support of half the test-trial copies (same runs, no own copy): other-half arm minus PLACEBO != 0 (two-sided)
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.C3: exposure exceeds that support at equal distinct-trial count: C1 - C2 > 0
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.descriptive: absolute BA; total half = own - P; support share = C2 / total (ratio of cohort means); full L - P on exposed / all / unexposed scored trials (replication within the new runs); full - total half; support of a half for unexposed trials; probability-scale versions; reproduction of R8-B's L and P arms (max |dp|, decision agreement)
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.interpretation_rule: C1 / C2 are identified by randomisation at HALF exposure density (each arm holds about k/2 of the k extra distinct test trials). They do not identify the decomposition of the full L - P without further assumptions; the manuscript reports them as a half-density decomposition and replaces the R8-B learning-curve bound wording whatever the outcome
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.no_SESOI: no equivalence region and no post-hoc relevance threshold; all results reported whatever their sign

design.arms: R4 frozen G2 manifest LEAKED (L) and PLACEBO (P), positionally aligned (verified: L and P differ exactly at the test-copy positions in all 210 folds); L1 = L with H2's copies replaced by P's rows at the same positions; L2 likewise for H1
design.split: exposed scored trials of each (seed, participant, fold) into H1 / H2, stratified by session, origin run, class and multiplicity in L; numpy default_rng([9201, seed, participant, fold]); alternate assignment within a stratum, fair coin for the extra member of an odd stratum (metadata only, outcome-blind)
design.model: EEGNet-8,2 as R4 / C2 / R8-B (kern 64 at 128 Hz, 4-40 Hz, per-trial channel z-score, 100 epochs, batch 64, Adam 1e-3, max-norm); one CRN group (L, L1, L2, P) with R8-B's pair seed _seed(8301, s, u, f) and group seed _seed(8302, s, u, f); A/A duplicate of L on every 10th fold (global order), must be exact
design.unit: participant (14): BA pooled over a participant's exposed scored trials per seed (own-exposed / other-half predictions per trial), mean over seeds 42-44; exact sign-flip (2^14), Holm over C1-C3
